title: Predicting the HER2 status in oesophageal cancer from tissue microarrays using convolutional neural networks.
summary: A convolutional neural network classified esophageal-cancer HER2 status from tissue-microarray samples; the study evaluated it on an independent 307-sample test set drawn from 1,602 samples.
ai_technology: A convolutional neural network analyzed tissue-microarray images to classify HER2 status.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: A convolutional neural network classified esophageal-cancer HER2 status from tissue-microarray samples; the study evaluated it on an independent 307-sample test set drawn from 1,602 samples.
evidence.unknown: The result is limited to the study’s tissue-microarray samples and independent 307-sample test set; it does not establish clinical deployment or treatment benefit.
evidence.ai_role: A convolutional neural network analyzed tissue-microarray images to classify HER2 status.
